label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.2 a.3…: What is the cause of being, goodness and every…
locator: I q.2 a.3 co., quarta via: et hoc dicimus Deum
interpretation: A nominal identification kept separate from the conclusion, as for the prima via (claim AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-UNDERSTOOD-AS-GOD-A): it reports how the name 'God' is used of the cause of being and every perfection. It is not used by any result.
